description: This PHP source file defines a class 'Smarty_Internal_Resource_Eval' that implements a template resource handler for Smarty templates. The class handles loading, decoding, and processing template content from 'eval' resources, which are embedded or dynamically evaluated templates.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Resource_Eval
classes.description: A class that handles Smarty template resources of type 'eval', providing methods for populating template sources, decoding resource strings, and generating resource identifiers.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Populates the source object with metadata, assigning a unique ID and timestamp based on the source name.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Retrieves the content of the template resource by decoding the resource name.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a resource string that may be base64 or URL encoded, based on prefixes.

methods.name: buildUniqueResourceName
methods.description: Generates a unique resource name for the template, decoding the resource name.

methods.name: getBasename
methods.description: Returns the basename for the resource, which in this implementation is an empty string.
